profiles.name: United Kingdom repeater-output coverage (RSGB)

sources.title: RSGB Band Plan January 2026
RSGB 144MHz Band Plan

profiles.notes: Broad RF coverage for repeater-output scanning; no repeater targets, directory data, or access parameters. The 2m allocation is RV48-RV63. The 70cm ranges are RSGB repeater-output allocations. Recommendation bounds only suggest this profile and never apply it automatically.

profiles.name: Southeastern US repeater-output coverage (SERA)

sources.title: SERA Coordination Policy and Guidelines, revision June 9 2024

profiles.notes: Broad RF coverage for repeater-output scanning. SERA NBD allocations include 2.5 kHz analogue and mixed-mode use. Overlapping SERA output allocations are represented as their RF coverage union. This profile is selectable by the operator; it has no recommendation bounds because the SERA territory is not accurately represented by a simple rectangle.

profiles.name: Germany repeater-output coverage (DARC)

sources.title: DARC 2m Bandplan, August 2017
DARC 70cm automatic-station Bandplan, May 2025, page 2

profiles.notes: Repeater-output RF coverage, including FM and digital/packet allocations; this does not add digital decoding. The 70cm digital/packet channel envelopes follow DARC footnotes 4 and 6. Legacy simplex 438.200-438.275 MHz is excluded. Other simplex, input, paging and broadband-experiment allocations are excluded. National sources reviewed September 2026; the currently linked 2m plan is dated 2017.

profiles.name: France repeater-output coverage (REF)

sources.title: REF Commission THF 144-146 MHz Bandplan, November 2017
REF Commission THF 430-440 MHz Bandplan, November 2017

profiles.notes: Repeater-output RF coverage from REF's national tables, reviewed September 2026; the tables are dated 2017. The 2m range retains the published allocation boundary. The 70cm range is the French NBFM output block. The 430.400-430.575 MHz digital-link/French repeater-input block and outputs labelled for other countries are excluded.

profiles.name: Austria repeater-output coverage (ÖVSV)

sources.title: ÖVSV UKW-Referat 2m Bandplan, retrieved September 2026
ÖVSV UKW-Referat 70cm Bandplan, retrieved September 2026

profiles.notes: Repeater-output RF coverage from ÖVSV's national tables. The published 70cm relay-output envelope overlaps the listed 438.025 MHz OE Dapnet/POCSAG channel; inclusion does not identify every signal in that envelope as a repeater. Input, simplex and satellite allocations outside the output envelope are excluded.

profiles.name: Italy repeater-output coverage (MIMIT)

sources.title: MIMIT repeater circular, 16 May 2022, output-channel tables pages 10-11

profiles.notes: Repeater-output channel envelopes from MIMIT's explicit Uscita/Downlink tables, reviewed September 2026. These are first-to-last output channel centres, without added edge padding. MIMIT identifies 431.225-431.600 MHz as output and 432.825-433.200 MHz as input; an ARI webpage reverses those labels, so this profile follows the ministry table. Inputs and satellite allocations are excluded.

profiles.name: Australia repeater-output coverage (WIA/ACMA)

sources.title: WIA Australian Amateur Radio Band Plan - Feb 2026
ACMA RALI AA3: Amateur (assigned) repeater station (146 MHz band), final release v5.0, 23 October 2024
ACMA RALI AA4: Amateur (assigned) repeater station (438 MHz band), final release v5.0, 23 October 2024

profiles.notes: Broad RF coverage for national repeater-output scanning. WIA Feb 2026 allocation boundaries are used; ACMA AA3/AA4 Oct 2024 channel plans corroborate assigned transmit populations. Inputs, links, simplex, satellite, and low-power hotspot-only allocations are excluded. 2m Block C is digital-only/data and 147.0125-147.3875 includes D/E special-use sharing; 70cm Block B 439.7900-440.0000 permits either -7 or -5 MHz offset. No targets, tones, credentials, or digital decoding are implied.

profiles.name: Argentina repeater-output coverage (ENACOM/RCA)

sources.title: ENACOM Resolución E 3635/2017, Annex A frequency table, official government copy
ENACOM Resolución 1186/2024, Resolución 3635/2017 - modificación
Radio Club Argentino, Reglamento General de Radioaficionados, compiled August 2025

profiles.notes: Repeater-output RF coverage using ENACOM Annex A allocation boundaries (Resolution 3635/2017), cross-checked against RCA's August 2025 copy and reviewed September 2026. The two 2m output blocks and the 433-435 MHz output block share spectrum with simplex; not every signal within them is a repeater. The national table's repeater-input and satellite blocks are excluded. Digital/mixed-mode RF coverage does not add digital decoding. No individual repeater data is included.

profiles.name: Belgium repeater-output coverage (UBA)

sources.title: UBA current bandplan references, retrieved September 2026
IARU Region 1 VHF Bandplan, December 2020, linked by UBA
IARU Region 1 UHF Bandplan, effective December 2020, linked by UBA
UBA Belgian unmanned-station list, February 2023, TX-frequency tables pages 3-7

profiles.notes: Repeater-output RF coverage from UBA-linked bandplans, corroborated by UBA's Belgian TX-frequency list. The high UHF envelope extends to 439.5875 MHz to cover documented Belgian duplex outputs beyond the regional table's 439.425 MHz endpoint; this is a coverage envelope, not a newly inferred allocation. Digital/mixed-mode outputs are included without adding digital decoding. Input, satellite, simplex/link and paging blocks are excluded. Sources reviewed September 2026; currently linked plans/list date from 2020/2023.
